basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | project engineer: PhD degree Or Master`s degree in Engineering/Design + 3 yrs exp. Or Bachelor`s degree in Engineering/Design + 6 yrs exp.Preferred: PhD in Electronics, Electrical or Computer Science

salary_details.project engineer: Rs. 70,000 per month with 20% HRA and medical facility
salary_details.details: The post also includes medical facility and 20% HRA as per the project terms.

selection_process: Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed via E-mail about the offline interview.
how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati.
Search for the project title "An Advanced Knowledge and Skilling Hub" or the relevant position advertisement number.
Carefully follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.
Submit your online application on or before 13 October 2026.
Keep track of your application status from the application portal and check your email for interview updates.
important_instructions: The interview mode is offline and will be held at the 7th Floor, Research Building, IIT Guwahati. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the test or interview. Shortlisted candidates will receive interview details via E-mail. Candidates facing technical assistance issues during the online application process may contact [email protected].
